description: Get the assigned driver's live GPS position, vehicle details, photo, ETA and the journey (pickup → drop-off, pickup time). This is the COMPLETE answer to 'where is my driver' / 'show me the driver' — call it once and answer from its result; do NOT also call lookup_booking unless the customer asks about the booking itself (price, payment, changes). The card it renders keeps updating by itself, so never call it again just to refresh. GPS updates every 2 minutes with tunnel interpolation. Ask the customer for BOTH their booking reference AND the email address used at booking — same as our website manage-booking login. Do not call this tool without both values.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — either "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869", as on the confirmation email) or the numeric LT reservation ID (e.g. "966244"). Both formats accepted.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly
